answer: In a decentralized consensus network, a Sybil-resistant mechanism utilizes a reputation system anchored to a unique digital identity, tied to a proof-of-stake consensus algorithm. Each AI agent is assigned a distinct identity, analogous to a stellar object within a nebula, which requires a deposit of computational resources, akin to extracting valuable minerals from basalt. An attacker attempting to create multiple fake identities must expend substantial resources, equivalent to navigating a treacherous inlet, making it economically infeasible to launch a Sybil attack.
